findings.reason: Evidence confirms the alarm and lack of maintenance, but does not prove the loss was 'unplanned' or definitively the root cause of the outages.
The cited alert text lists the sites and time but does not explicitly state the location is 'Grand Tunis'.
The evidence explicitly states MW-0010 was on LNK-TUN-01-C and T5 confirms no maintenance on LNK-TUN-01-B.
The cited tool output explicitly reports 'No changes' for the specified nodes and time window.
The topology outputs confirm the parent-child relationships and that the links serve the specific sites via the stated core.
The alarms are cited for the correct nodes, and T5 confirms no maintenance window covered LNK-TUN-01-B during the incident.
